## Mapping MPI processes to GPUs {transition="slide-in none-out"}

Best practice: one MPI process per GPU.

    .link { stroke: #444; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: none; } .cpu-link, .gpu-link { stroke: #444; stroke-width: 6; fill: none; } .rail { stroke: #666; stroke-width: 2; fill: none; } .tap { stroke: #666; stroke-width: 2; fill: none; } .dot { fill: #444; }

```{=html}
<script>
window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  Reveal.on("slidechanged", event => {
    if (event.currentSlide.id !== "process-mapping-animation-end") return;

    const svg = event.currentSlide.querySelector(".process-mapping-animation-end");
    svg.classList.remove("animate-processes");
    void svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    svg.classList.add("animate-processes");
  });
});
</script>
```
